name: qlrisk_price_convertible_bond
title: Price a ConvertibleBond
description:
Price one Convertible Bond (qlrisk ConvertibleBond).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, face_value=100, coupon_pct=2, conversion_ratio, ticker=SPX, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, issuer, spot, position.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 100} gives NPV 98.05 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
